column8: ["All three seats read as deep, tilted cups with visible inner walls; paint flat, concentric openings viewed straight down.","The teal seats have bright lower-right rims and dark upper-left interiors; replace this directional shading with symmetric tonal bands under even light.","The three connecting bonds read as narrow, layered rails pinched at the seat junctions; paint broad, continuous brass channels with clear, unobstructed mouths."]

["All three seats have dark upper interiors and bright lower-right rims, creating directional lighting that will visibly rotate with the machine; use concentric, symmetric tones.","The seats read as tilted cups with visible inner walls and heavy lower outer lips, rather than circular seats viewed straight down; flatten their depth cues.","The brass links are muddy brown with nearly black edge bands, obscuring the broad functional channels; simplify them into clear, continuous rubbed-brass forms."]
